correctness.rationale: For the complex very general symplectic (Z/2)^2-invariant quartic K3 of Piroddi family no.3, smoothness forces each binary face discriminant nonzero and a_i!=0. Its quotient S:z0 z1 z2 z3+Q(z)^2=0 has two A1 nodes on each of six coordinate edges. Each face section is 2D_i for a smooth conic D_i; on resolution 12 exceptional (-2) curves and four strict transform (-2) conics form the subdivision of a doubled K4 with each face incident with six exceptional curves. Locally uv+w²=0 shows H=2C_i+F_i. The mod-2 face incidence rank equals three, giving index 2^3 in A1^12⊕<4> and lattice discriminant 2^14/2^6=2^8, rank 13. Piroddi Proposition 2.4.1 plus Theorem 3.2.3 independently identify the very-general NS lattice with exactly same rank/discriminant, hence index one. Independent exact combinatorial lattice replay confirms arithmetic, not analytic smoothness/quotient assertions.

originality.rationale: Piroddi 2024 independently establishes the source V4 fixed-point count, quotient model and abstract generic Néron–Severi lattice, receiving full prior credit. The reviewed additional result explicitly realizes and proves generators through four geometrically visible coordinate conics plus twelve node exceptional curves, their doubled-K4 incidence, and index/discriminant saturation; this explicit generator configuration is not stated in the inspected primary Piroddi sections. Schaffler 2017/2018 considers a different family of Klein-four K3 covers with different dimension and geometry. Resultary search found no statement-level matching generator theorem.
